title: Rank compression followed delayed generalization in tested Transformers
summary: In 29 one-layer Transformer runs that developed delayed generalization on modular arithmetic, the steepest effective-rank drop followed the rise in test accuracy by about 900 training steps. In a separate intervention, restricting embedding rank prevented delayed generalization in 15 of 20 runs.

source_review.scope: v1 one-layer Transformer results, rank intervention and Appendix E

evidence.tested: The paper used a predefined test-accuracy threshold and compared rank restrictions with factorized full-rank models across seeds.
evidence.unknown: Results concern small arithmetic models. Timing and intervention findings do not exclude other roles for representation compression in other training regimes.
evidence.ai_role: Trained modular-arithmetic Transformers and matched factorized controls serve as instruments for evaluating weight rank and generalization timing.
